sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Consumer Defensive / Farm Products · Indonesia. PT Dharma Satya Nusantara Tbk operates in the palm oil and wood product business in Indonesia. It plants, produces, and sells palm oil products, including crude palm oil, palm kernel, and palm kernel oil. It also provides various wood products, such as panels and engineered floors and doors; and produces compressed natural gas from palm oil mill effluent and biomass. It also exports its products.
